title: It’s ok
text: It’s ok. The plastic cup the star sits on top of split when I stuck a tree branch inside for balance. I discarded the cup and carefully place the star on top. Sits sideways, but it’s stable

product_metadata.title: Kurt Adler 10-Light 8-Point Star Christmas Treetop, 8-Inch, Clear
features: Clear 8 Point Star Light Up Christmas Tree Topper Holiday Decoration UL0130C New
description: This Kurt Adler 10-Light 8-inch 8 Point Clear Star Treetop is a fun and festive addition to your holiday décor. This treetop is a classic star treetop with a twist. In addition to the main design there is another 8 Point Clear Star designed inside the larger one. In the center of the treetop, is a 4 point star. Three stars are all combined into one treetop creating a classic treetop look with a modern twist. Includes 30-inch Green Lead Wire, 4 Spare Bulbs and 1 Fuse.
